title: Host-owned stereo route selection and interactive context-menu controls

needles: keeps independent left and right selections
controls clamp and notify through their callbacks

installed_sdk.rationale: The route-channel and context-menu control APIs are public headers with compatibility fallbacks. Hosts that do not support independent channel routing retain bus-level behavior, and ordinary ContextMenu action rows retain their existing selection and dismissal semantics. The delivery remains pending installed-consumer proof.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: These APIs operate on live host routing and live view input; no offline Timeline command or document schema changes.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No MCP tool, schema, or handler is added.

live_product_control.rationale: The catalog and menu callbacks are host/view plumbing, not a new broker operation or product-control grant.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: No design-time agent capability or importer authority changes.
